purpose: Teach: 見え隠れ/王位/財投/先立ち/国務省/血縁/検疫/受難

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合の戦略が見え隠れする時こそ警戒しろ
lines.en: When our competitors' strategies start to show through the cracks, that's when we stay sharp.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured pace. Each phrase lands with quiet force. The tone of someone who has seen patterns others miss. No room for complacency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社長交代を王位継承のように描く報道に注意します
lines.en: Understood. I'll watch the media coverage about the president's transition carefully—make sure we're not reading into the narrative too much.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Lighter touch than the boss. Shows he's already thinking through the angles. Steady, reliable tone. A nod of agreement with intelligence behind it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、財投の動向を投資判断に活かせ
lines.en: And use what we learn about the investment landscape to sharpen our own judgment calls.
lines.style: Firm, declarative. Direct eye contact implied. Each clause lands with purpose. No softening—this is expectation, not suggestion. Slightly faster tempo, building on what he just said.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業に先立ち市場調査を進めます
lines.en: Understood. Before we launch into new ventures, I'll make sure the market research is solid.
lines.style: Assured, practical. Kenji showing he's already two steps ahead. Not defensive—just competent. Warm undertone: he knows the boss values thorough work. Rhythmic, professional cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、米国国務省の動きにも注意しろ
lines.en: Don't overlook what's happening at the US State Department either.
lines.style: Clipped, serious. A final instruction that broadens the aperture. Tempo stays tight. The implication: global attention is part of your job now. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。血縁採用は厳格に禁止します
lines.en: Understood. And we'll be strict about nepotism in hiring—no exceptions, no grey areas.
lines.style: Clear commitment. Kenji making a promise back to the boss. Slight emphasis on 'strict' to show he understands the weight. Calm but resolute. The kind of agreement that closes a loop.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外出張時の検疫対応を整えろ
lines.en: Sort out the quarantine protocols for overseas assignments right away.
lines.style: Brisk, practical urgency. The tone of someone moving to the next item. Slightly more direct than before—time is a factor. Lean forward energy in the voice, not in the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営陣の受難期にも社員を支えます
lines.en: Will do. We'll make sure our people are supported through whatever comes next.
lines.style: Warm closure beneath the professionalism. Kenji shifting subtly—moving from procedure to principle. He's understood the deeper message: look ahead, but don't abandon the team. Steady, grounded final note.
